doc.name: A — bath textiles catalogue, water reflection, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: waffle-weave bath towel stack
Category: bath textiles
Shot programme: water reflection
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You act as lead photographer and set designer for a bath textiles catalogue. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the hero three-quarter in a water reflection treatment.

SUBJECT. A waffle-weave bath towel stack. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Three-quarter hero angle at label height with the product a touch above eye line. Shoot on a 180mm long macro at f/1.8, framing for leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down. Stage the product on or against raw board-formed concrete, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
